name: application-emoji-picker
title: Emoji / Reaction Picker
description: Searchable emoji picker with category tabs, a recently-used grid, and per-emoji accessible labels.
useWhen: Letting users add an emoji reaction to a comment, message, or post — pair with `comment-thread` or `chat-bubbles`.
Building a text composer that needs an emoji-insert affordance alongside formatting controls.
You want quick access to recently-used emoji before making users browse full categories.
avoidWhen: You only need a small, fixed set of quick reactions (e.g. 👍 ❤️ 😂) — a plain row of buttons is lighter weight than a full picker.
The product doesn't need free-form emoji selection at all — don't add this just because it's available.
You need skin-tone variants or full Unicode coverage — this pattern ships a small curated set per category as a starting point, not an exhaustive emoji database.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width popover-style panel; anchor it to a trigger button and let your popover/positioning layer handle placement near viewport edges.
accessibility: Category tabs use role="tablist"/role="tab" with aria-selected reflecting the active category.
The emoji grid uses role="listbox"/role="option" and every emoji button has a real aria-label describing it (e.g. "Thumbs up"), since the emoji glyph alone is not a reliable accessible name.
The search field has an associated (visually hidden) label rather than relying on placeholder text alone.
An empty search result state is rendered as visible text ("No matching emoji"), not a silently empty grid.

variants.title: Emoji / Reaction Picker
variants.description: Search field, category tabs (Recent/Smileys/Gestures/Nature), and a recently-used emoji grid.
accessibility: Search filters a real emoji list by label, and results reflect the active category, not a static grid.

variants.title: Emoji / Reaction Picker (Dark)
variants.description: Emoji picker adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Active-tab and hover backgrounds are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
